title: Friends canoe across Canada, raising $130K for northern communities

blocks.text: Nolan Aziz and Will Vyse are part of a trio that canoed from Tadoussac, Que., to a Vancouver beach, portaging when they couldn't paddle. Aziz and Vyse describe their trip, which raised $130,000 for True North Aid, a charity that helps northern and remote Indigenous communities.
